backend/main.mo: Main backend canister with user auth, profile management, and CRUD for prompts and categories.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old user/category state to the new schema without category IDs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files for build and dependency planning.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide for diagnosing deployment failures with steps, common issues, and quick fixes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and light/dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React app and favicon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling login, backend sync, prompt/category UI, and global state.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Standalone sign‑in screen prompting users to authenticate with Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/backend/BackendC: Shows backend connection loading or error states with optional reload action.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: Displays category list with selection, favorites toggle, and create/rename/delete dialogs.
Allows selecting multiple categories and creating new ones with duplicate checking.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog for renaming or deleting categories with usage warnings and duplicate checks.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Provides UI to export prompts/categories or import them from a JSON file into backend.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Generic confirmation dialog with customizable title, description, and confirm handler.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Renders prompt action buttons for copying, favoriting, duplicating, editing, and deleting.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Renders sanitized prompt HTML content safely to the page.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Dialog for creating or editing a prompt with fields for title, content, categories, and save handling.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Displays prompts in a responsive grid with categories, preview snippet, and action controls.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: Shows prompts in a vertical list with full title, categories, content preview, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Modal dialog that displays a prompt’s title and full rendered content for quick preview.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Renders prompts in a sortable table layout with category badges, modified date, actions, and preview dialog.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Search input with an icon and paste-cleaning handler for filtering prompts by text.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown for selecting prompt sorting mode such as alphabetical or date-based options.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: Toggle buttons to switch between list, grid, and table prompt views.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Utilities to validate II provider URLs, build logout URLs, manage logout navigation, and track pending logout state.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Provides the fixed return URL containing the required admin token fragment for post-logout redirects.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: React hook that reliably orchestrates II logout by clearing local auth first and then performing provider logout with return URL.
frontend/src/features/backend/actorDiagn: Provides structured logging utilities for backend actor creation, configuration, and connectivity errors.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: Defines mapping between frontend and backend prompt/category types and exposes CRUD API methods via an actor.
frontend/src/features/backend/useBackend: React hook that tracks backend actor readiness and logs diagnostics when actor creation fails.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: Syncs prompts and categories with the backend, performs connectivity checks, and loads data after authentication.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category list with add, rename, delete, set, and clear operations including case-insensitive rules.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: Provides a hook for copying text to clipboard with modern API fallback and temporary copied state.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories to a JSON file with metadata.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompts from a JSON file, validates structure, and resolves ID collisions.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines export data shape and validates imported prompt structures.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPastedT: Cleans pasted plain text or HTML, stripping artifacts and preserving readable structure.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPasteHa: Creates paste handlers that clean text and insert it correctly in input or contentEditable fields.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and case‑insensitive text search.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates simple unique IDs for prompts.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store managing prompts with CRUD, duplication, favorites, and category edits.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Provides sorting functions for prompts based on various sort modes.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Defines Prompt structure and enums for view and sort modes.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Converts HTML content to plain text by stripping tags and normalizing whitespace.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Sanitizes HTML, removing unsafe tags, normalizing spans, and preserving safe formatting.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: Rich text editor component with formatting buttons, color selection, and paste cleaning.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves UI preference data, specifically view mode, to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: React hook that auto-persists view mode changes to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages backend actor instances tied to Internet Identity, with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, state, and persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op function kept for compatibility; favicon now handled statically.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routes), persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS setup with theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugin configuration.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for category persistence features, including requirements, issues, and pending feature requests.
